mapIdentity.scope: Approximate 4.12 m square valve house inside the original upstream platform projection of mapped dam way 448005771, one third of the way along the mapped crest.

note: Rock-faced granite walls, one path-side door, two stone-blocked rear windows, and a flat overhanging roof on corbels. Shared dam ground reference aligns the valve house at the crest elevation.
